description: Original photographic-style jellyfish artwork for fictional ocean gameplay hazards. Pale rounded cuboid bells and tentacle bundles represent box jellyfish; amber domed/frilled animals represent the game label fire jellyfish. These are generated illustrations, not sourced wildlife photography, a precise biological plate or evidence of historical species prevalence.
generationPolicy: Created with transparent-background image generation; no external photographic pixels, watermark removal, or private source imagery. Original generated atlas retained byte-for-byte.
derivativePolicy: Each runtime WebP is an exact full-cell extraction from the source RGBA atlas, with no masking, rescaling, color adjustment, interpolation or pixel alteration. Lossless exact mode preserves all RGBA bytes, including RGB beneath transparency; equality was asserted after decoding.

records.anchorMethod: Approximate visual registration of bell centre within the complete unaltered frame, normalized from top-left. For side views the long tentacles make the complete-frame centre differ from bell centre.

limits: All full-cell edge alpha values are at most9/255, with alpha32 subject bounds inside each cell. No pixel cleanup or masking was applied. The generated image preview retains coloured RGB beneath alpha0; those invisible RGB values are deliberately preserved by exact lossless derivatives.
